title: Data security transfer and update method based on blockchain and federated learning
assignee: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

pse.problem: Inefficiencies and potential security hazards in the traditional architecture of federal learning due to centralized control, single-point faults, data security issues, and lack of transparency.
pse.solution_function: The invention introduces a method for secure, transparent, and efficient circulation and updating of model parameters by integrating blockchain technology with federal learning. This method ensures safety, privacy, and reliability in multi-party collaboration through decentralized, transparent, and tamper-proof data transactions.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of a blockchain structure with a chain data structure and encryption algorithm, and the federal learning framework for distributed model training. Each participating terminal updates and records model parameters as transactions on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and traceability.
pse.solution_implementation: The method operates by locally training models on each terminal device in the federal learning process, then uploading the model parameters as transactions to the blockchain. The blockchain guarantees non-tamper property, verifies the integrity of data sources, and ensures the reliability and traceability of parameter updates.
pse.effect: The proposed method improves the safety, transparency, and efficiency of the federal learning process, addressing potential security hazards, single-point faults, and data circulation opacity in the traditional architecture.
